description: Discover ways to connect, serve, and grow with our church community.

opportunities.title: Children's Ministry
opportunities.description: It is not just a service group but also a ministry of its own: a colorful, energetic, entertaining and dynamic ministry focused on teaching the word of faith to children from age one month to 12 years.

opportunities.title: Choir
opportunities.description: The Music Ministry is made up of God-fearing men and women, who are talented music ministers and are committed to the work of God in music.

opportunities.title: Decoration
opportunities.description: The Decoration Ministry is made up of creative individuals who beautify the church environment for services and special events.

opportunities.title: Drama Team
opportunities.description: The mission of this team is to use theater as a ministry to encourage, instruct, and uplift the body of Christ.

opportunities.title: Hospitality
opportunities.description: This team loves to create a friendly and welcoming atmosphere in and around our church services.

opportunities.title: Sanctuary Keepers
opportunities.description: We have a team of committed men and women, devoted to making sure that the house of God is clean and tidy.

opportunities.title: Security
opportunities.description: The security, health and safety of all is the priority of this team.

opportunities.title: Media Team
opportunities.description: This team maintains and sets up musical instruments and microphones for all our services.

opportunities.title: Medical Team (The Gilead Squad)
opportunities.description: Our worship services are undeniably safe at all times, and by God's grace, we have had no incidence since inception.

opportunities.title: Protocol Team
opportunities.description: This team performs protocol duties during services, such as manning the church entrance, main sanctuary, and Pastor's office.

opportunities.title: Transportation Team
opportunities.description: The objective of this ministry is to provide transportation services and relieve our members who have no alternatives.

opportunities.title: Usher Team
opportunities.description: Members of this team create a friendly and welcoming atmosphere in the church services.

opportunities.title: Follow-up Team
opportunities.description: This team dedicates itself to connecting first time guests and new converts to the church.

opportunities.title: Parking Team
opportunities.description: This team ensures safety from the moment guests pull onto our property.
